title: Billing Coordination Note: Pay Plan Discount Taken Back When a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Is Cancelled
content:
A Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is billed through a Cardinal Billing Account, whose pay plan may carry a plan discount percentage. When the policy is cancelled at the named insured's request, the plan discount taken back follows the pay plan of the policy's billing account.

## Rule

| Pay plan of the policy's Cardinal Billing Account | Plan discount taken back |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | The whole plan discount percentage of that plan |
| Any other plan that carries a plan discount | Half (0.5) of its plan discount percentage |
| A plan without a plan discount | None |

The plan discount percentage is the one carried by the pay plan the Cardinal Billing Account is on.

## Points of judgement

- An account on the Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan: the whole of that plan's discount percentage is taken back.
- An account on another plan that carries a plan discount: half of that plan's discount percentage is taken back. For a hypothetical plan discount of 2 percent, 1 percent is taken back.
- An account on a plan whose plan discount is nil: nothing is taken back.

The pay plan is the one recorded on the Cardinal Billing Account linked to the policy.
